FEAT-6-S145.title: Consent Data Schema & Validation Contracts
FEAT-6-S145.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for consent tiers, consent state transitions, and de-identified payload structures used across services and APIs.

FEAT-6-S146.title: Consent Persistence & Storage Controls
FEAT-6-S146.description: Implement persistence rules for consent decisions including tier-based storage restrictions, ensuring no identifiable data is stored without Tier 2 consent and enforcing Safe Harbor de-identification.

FEAT-6-S147.title: Consent Audit Logging Integration
FEAT-6-S147.description: Integrate consent decisions and transitions with debug_logger to create an auditable trail of consent status, de-identification actions, and storage decisions for compliance tracking.

FEAT-6-S148.title: Consent Workflow Unit & Integration Tests
FEAT-6-S148.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering consent tier logic, escalation paths, API enforcement, de-identification behavior, and persistence gating.
